name: Spiced Mexican Chocolate Tart with Cinnamon Ganache (Night 1)
whyItWorks: Smooth dark chocolate-cinnamon ganache in a pastry shell, though Mexican chocolate often includes a subtle pinch of cayenne/ancho.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Best saved for remission days; ask your server if there is chili heat in the ganache and pair with a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Subtle ancho/cayenne warmth in Mexican chocolate
